description:
List the fields (name → type) a core model CAN have in an Odoo major - from the real .deb,
    so an agent writing/porting a module knows the field vocabulary and doesn't invent names.
    `type` is the Odoo field type ('Char', 'Many2one->res.partner', …). READ-ONLY.

    IMPORTANT: this is the Community + Enterprise + localization UNION - presence here does NOT mean
    the field is in a given install (Enterprise / localization fields appear even on Community). For
    what is ACTUALLY in a specific database, use odoo_db_model_fields(host, db, model). Covers ~28
    core models; returns covered=False for anything else. Use `odoo_field_check` for one field,
    `odoo_version_diff` for what changed between majors.
name: odoo_model_fields
